random.description: This is a microscopic image of a tissue section stained with Grocott's methenamine silver (GMS). The tissue contains numerous darkly stained, round to oval fungal yeast-like structures embedded within inflammatory or stromal cells. The presence of these encapsulated or distinct fungal elements is characteristic of a deep fungal infection, most likely histoplasmosis or cryptococcosis. The Gomori's methenamine silver stain highlights the fungal cell walls clearly in black against the greenish counterstain.
